page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It provisions 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical processor cores via multithreading. System memory is configured at 8.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Architectural capabilities include support for AVX, AVX-512F, BMI2, ADX, and AES hardware cryptography instructions. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage and includes no GPU hardware, operating with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Empirical benchmark results demonstrate entry-tier performance indicative of the underlying Broadwell microarchitecture. In raw compute assessments, the instance recorded a stress-ng single-core score of 1099.19 and a multi-core score of 2893.96. Geekbench testing registered 896.0 for single-core and 1975.0 for multi-core processing, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 3619.18. Memory throughput benchmarks show uncached large-block read speeds of 19.1 GB/sec and write speeds of 17.26 GB/sec. Networked and application-level workloads yielded 2.87 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and a static web serving throughput rate of 2.43 GB/sec.

Due to its lower relative throughput across processor and memory subsystems, ecs.sn1ne.xlarge is characterized by conservative compute capacity. The instance offers predictable performance via dedicated vCPUs for low-intensity continuous tasks. It is best aligned with lightweight web applications, background processing daemons, test or staging environments, and entry-level build or CI/CD pipelines that do not require large memory allocations or local disk throughput.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor on the KVM hypervisor. The instance provides 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, coupled with 8.0 GB of system memory to maintain a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Its architecture incorporates 35 MB of L3 cache, hardware AVX-512F support, and a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. The server does not bundle local ephemeral storage or GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage. Benchmark evaluations place its computational throughput in lower performance tiers, showing a Geekbench multi-core score of 1975.0 and 2.87 million Redis SET operations per second. With steady dedicated execution and a modest resource profile, ecs.sn1ne.xlarge serves basic web hosting, continuous integration tasks, light background jobs, and staging environments.
